integrity: All six scientific documents plus a standalone standard-library finite checker and its actual execution output are embedded, byte-counted and SHA-256 hashed. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complementary open-neighborhood complex has a uniform nonequivariant homotopy type for n >= 4. Combinatorial Alexander duality supplies complete integral homology of crown dominance complexes, not their homotopy type. The low-n boundary and group actions are not classified. Indexed novelty checks are not exhaustive.
title: Crown-graph dominance homology from a two-clique neighborhood wedge
